title: Documentation | Amigo — AI Career Companion & Interview Copilot
description: Learn how to use Amigo, the real-time AI copilot for live video and coding interviews. Setup guides, platform support, billing, and best practices.
html:
Amigo is a real-time AI copilot designed to give you an undetectable competitive edge during live job interviews, video, behavioral, and coding alike. Whether you're interviewing at a FAANG company or a fast-growing startup, Amigo listens, understands, and delivers personalized guidance in seconds.

New to Amigo? Start with the Quick Start guide to get set up in under 5 minutes.

What is Amigo?

Amigo is a desktop application (Windows & macOS) that runs invisibly alongside your interview window. It uses advanced audio processing to detect questions in real time and surfaces suggested answers through a discreet overlay that is completely hidden from screen sharing and recording software.

  • Real-time question detection with smart filler filtering, so only genuine questions trigger suggestions
  • AI-generated, personalized answers based on your resume, role, and copilot profile preferences
  • 100% invisible, not captured by Zoom, Google Meet, or Teams screen sharing, verified by automatic system readiness checks
  • Lightning-fast responses in under 2 seconds, streamed token by token so you can start reading immediately
  • Two session formats: Live Interview for behavioural and technical rounds, Coding Test for timed assessments with maximum AI capability
  • Adjustable response length (Concise, Balanced, Detailed), changeable on the fly during your interview

Key Features

Stealth Mode

Invisible to all screen sharing & recording tools. Verified by automatic system checks.

<2s Response

AI suggestions stream in token by token, so you can start reading before the answer finishes generating.

Personalized AI

Tailored to your resume, role, copilot profile, and adjustable response length.

Smart Filtering

Multi-layer filtering strips fillers, detects your voice, and only triggers on real questions.

Coding Test Mode

Dedicated mode for LeetCode & system design that bypasses classification for max AI capability.

Privacy First

Audio processing secured on the native backend. Zero recordings, zero logs, sessions wiped instantly.

Supported Platforms

Amigo operates as a system-level overlay and works seamlessly with all major interview and video conferencing platforms:

  • Zoom (all versions)
  • Google Meet
  • Microsoft Teams
  • Cisco Webex
  • Skype
  • LeetCode (browser-based)
  • HackerRank
  • CoderPad
  • Any browser-based video platform

Amigo is currently available for Windows 10/11 and macOS 12+. Mobile support is not available at this time.

How It Works

Amigo uses a multi-stage pipeline to deliver real-time assistance:

  1. System Check: Before every session, Amigo verifies stealth mode, always-on-top, audio permissions, and network connectivity so you never start with a misconfigured setup.
  2. Audio Capture: Amigo captures system audio and your candidate microphone on separate native threads. Your voice is identified and filtered out so only interviewer questions trigger responses.
  3. Speech Recognition: Audio is sent to a low-latency cloud transcription service via the secure native backend, with progressive interim transcripts streamed back in real time. A filler-rejection layer strips out "umm", "you know", and 100+ other conversational fillers before anything reaches the AI.
  4. Smart Classification: An NLP engine with grammar-aware pattern matching classifies each question as coding or conversational, with a theory-frame guard and dialog-context awareness for follow-up questions.
  5. AI Generation: The question is routed to the right model tier based on your session format and intent. Responses stream in token by token, personalised to your resume and copilot profile.
  6. Overlay Rendering: The answer appears in a floating, screen-share-safe overlay that only you can see.
